about.description: I'm a Software Engineering student at PUC-Campinas focused on data and Artificial Intelligence, especially Machine Learning and how to turn data into answers for real-world problems. Much of my path has been built through scientific research, an area I hold dear and where I learned to investigate carefully, question results and share what I discover. I also enjoy seeing technology come to life, whether by building dashboards that support decisions or developing systems that make an impact. I'm always looking for challenges that bring together data, AI and purpose.

water_article.name: Article in Water (MDPI)
water_article.description: Systematic literature review mapping how Artificial Intelligence and remote sensing are being used to monitor inland surface water quality, bringing together tools, methods, challenges and future directions.
water_article.caption: Artificial Intelligence and Remote Sensing for Inland Surface Water Quality Monitoring: A Systematic Literature Review of Tools, Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions • Water 2026, 18(12), 1459

hydromonitor.name: HydroMonitor
hydromonitor.description: Water monitoring system that tracks real-time water quality and quantity data from the PCJ river basins. Using Machine Learning models, it identifies when something deviates from the expected behavior and issues alerts explaining each one. It grew out of the Bacias Hidrográficas Inteligentes research project (FAPESP).

search_ai_meetup.name: Search & AI Meetup BR Landing Page
search_ai_meetup.description: Landing page developed for the Search & AI Meetup BR community. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, featuring a responsive layout, reusable component-based structure, i18n translation support, and subtle animations with Framer Motion.

planify_ai.name: Planify AI
planify_ai.description: Full-stack application that generates personalized study plans using AI. Includes Firebase authentication, a dashboard to manage plans and progress, a free credits system to limit usage, and a Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB and Prisma.
